outreach_notes: My 15 years in regulated test automation (C#/.NET, FDA V&V) and lifelong love of games could strengthen PTW's QA services—I'd welcome discussing senior SDET or QA lead needs.
research_notes: PTW/Side is a game QA and services company. Facts show third-round layoffs in São Paulo (2025-09), 15 US and six Brazil cuts, 45 global layoffs, and an acquisition (Ghostpunch). A Brazilian studio opened 2025-05. No remote policy, no QA openings, no people listed.
